newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kanto Bank to write off 19.2 bln yen in bad loans.
newsitem.headline: Kanto Bank to write off 19.2 bln yen in bad loans.

text.p: Kanto Bank Ltd said on Monday it expects to write off problem loans worth about 19.2 billion yen in the 1996/97 business year ending March 31.
The bank said it expects its total bad loans to amount to 48.6 billion yen at the end of 1996/97. Of that amount, loans to bankrupt clients are estimated at 7.9 billion yen.

Meanwhile, loans with interest payments in arrears for over six months are expected to reach 38.4 billion yen, and loans for which interest have been reduced or forgiven are expected to reach 2.3 billion yen, it said.
The bank's capital-adequacy ratio is expected to be 4.0 percent at the end of the current business year, down from 4.5 percent at the end of 1995/96.
